pages.text: Move like your life depends on it — Footwork adds dodging, strafing, and positional combat mechanics that reward active movement in every fight.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Footwork is available from T1 and changes how every combat encounter feels. Dodge rolling costs stamina and has a cooldown — positioning and timing matter.$(br2)$(bold)Class synergy:$() Ranger and Samurai classes benefit most from Footwork's mobility options. Berserker and Vanguard can use it defensively to close gaps or disengage.

$(bold)Where the reference lives:$() each Footwork move is described on its item tooltip, and the mechanics are listed in JEI.$(br2)$(bold)Next: practice the dodge roll on a zombie before you need it on a boss.$()
